title: Chapter 446 Human Race Dominates The List
content:
Chapter 446 Human Race Dominates The List

At this time, through the constantly improved genius list, not only are the names of the person on the list, the background behind him, a brief introduction, and the realm.

"Huh? Why are there only a few supreme realms?"

Ying Wuzhi was very surprised. Looking at the few supreme realms on the list, I suddenly felt that the pressure was not that great.

It seems that this is the case.

"Oh, the competition is very fierce."

Just as the shadows were watching without a trace, the Qinglong of the Heavenly Demon Clan suddenly defeated the Palace Ting of the Human Emperor Palace and rushed into the top three.

At this time, the battle between Xu Xingcai and Lingqi, the Holy Spirit Clan in the Human Emperor Palace, has come to an end.

"What? Gong Ting actually lost to Qinglong of the Heavenly Demon Clan again?!"

The powerful humans present said in disbelief.

The strong men of the Tiande Clan were secretly happy. Qinglong grew up in the core area of the Tiande Clan since he was a child. He was trained by the best resources in the Tiande Clan and taught by the clan leader himself that he could beat the situation. Gong Ting did not surprise them.

After all, the human race also has its own genius that it has devoted itself to.

But the powerful genius present had not yet recovered, another mutation occurred.

The top-ranked Holy Spirit Clan spirit fell to second place, replaced by Xu Xingcai, the Human Emperor Palace.

Seeing this result, the powerful human race began to cheer after a brief moment of being stunned.

"I didn't expect that Xingcai would actually bring such surprises."

"Yes, it's really unpredictable."

The human strong man did not know that Xu Xingcai's victory and Gong Ting's contribution were obtained by Gong Ting's death.

Immediately afterwards, the Qinglong of the Heavenly Demon Clan began to fight with the Holy Spirit Clan.

"You say that this time the Spirit of the Holy Spirit Clan is strong, and the Qinglong of the Heavenly Demon Clan is strong."

One person suddenly came up with this topic.

"That must be spiritual and stronger."

"Oh? How do you say this?"

The man said directly, "It's been a while since Lingqi has dominated the top spot. The Qinglong of the Heavenly Demon Clan has been here for so long before he can get on the list. If he can win, wouldn't it be in the morning?"

Hearing this, some people nodded secretly.

This statement makes sense.

But some people also disagree, "The masters always take action in the end. The Qinglong of the Wantian Demon Clan wants to make the final appearance."

Everyone has their own reasons.

Listening to the disputes around people, he looked at the shadow of the Tianjiao List and simply found a place to sit down. No hurry. It's still some time before the Tianjiao List ends. I just need to be on the list at the end. It was the task assigned to him by Lu Xue.

The only bad thing is,

Ying Wuzhi glared at the young man in the desert who was sitting beside him with resentment.

Without ignoring the hostile gaze of the shadow without a trace, Huang Weiqing smiled and said, "Young Master Ying, aren't you still on the list?"

Ying Wuzhi grinned, his smile a little cold, "What's the hurry? Let me observe the situation first."

He was also very curious about how far the Qinglong of the Heavenly Demon Clan could reach.

As far as he knows, Lu Xue also has a dragon around her, she is extremely powerful and has something to do with the Heavenly Demon Clan.

I just don’t know if this Qinglong has any contact with the one next to Lu Xue.

The Tianjiao List fell into peace again, and everyone was waiting patiently for the result.

On the other hand, the battle on the combat power list has reached its climax.

"Hahahaha, I am worthy of being the Lord of the Palace. I am truly invincible!"

The powerful human race laughed to the sky.

Wu Hui, the head of the Human Emperor Palace, rushed to the top of the combat power list, and defeated all the top strong men.

Whether it is the long-famous old-generation strong man, the leader of the Holy Spirit clan, or even the madman, they are all defeated by Wu Hui and become the stepping stone for Wu Hui to reach the top.

Subsequently, Shi Zhong, a veteran human race, was on the list, and he also pushed the ball all the way, and finally stopped at the third place, second only to Wu Hui and Zhan Madman.

In this way, the top three combat power lists were all occupied by the human race, which made the rest of the tribes present breathless.

What is the strongest? The human race interprets everything.

"I didn't expect that the madman couldn't even defeat Senior Shi."

The human strong man dared not believe it.

Mo Chou sighed softly, "Senior Shi Zhong is old and has limited energy. In addition, Senior Shi Zhong has not taken action for a long time, so he is naturally a little unfamiliar, and it is normal that he can't beat that crazy man."

At this time, it was almost time to get to the end of the combat power list.

The rankings on the list have become stable and rarely change.

Everyone looked at the names on the combat power list and felt a lot of emotion.

Many powerful people who once thought they had already fallen appeared on the list, and some powerful people who were not as powerful as rumors also appeared on the list unexpectedly.

A race with an average strength and the strongest in the field, the most powerful in the Supreme Realm, came out to attack the battle power list, shocking for a moment.

Everyone present was familiar with the last one.

That was the first Elder of the Dark River to make the list.

He, who once ranked first, has now become the tail end of the crane on the list, but he is already very satisfied with this.

"Don't come back to the strong, otherwise I will go down."

At one point in the square, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River kept praying in his heart.

As long as another person who is stronger than him comes, he will be eliminated. If he is eliminated, then the efforts of these few days will be in vain.

Of course, it cannot be considered in vain.

At least in countless life-and-death battles, his strength has been greatly improved. As long as he is given a period of time, he will be 30% sure to impact the holy grade Supreme.

Don’t underestimate these 30%, this is already very scary.

There are only a few holy-grade supremes in the entire Chaos Realm, which is enough to show the value of holy-grade supremes.

At this time, some strong men suddenly wondered: "Strange, why are the strong men of the Heavenly Demon Clan on the list so few?"

As soon as these words were spoken, all the strong people present reacted.

This is indeed very strange.

At this moment, the top strong men in the entire Chaos Realm gathered here. Can they not know who is the top strong men in the Heavenly Demon Clan?

But now, none of the strong men in their memory appeared.

Everyone looked at the few Tian Yao tribe members who were heading for them.

Most of the Tian Yao tribe members were unaware of this, while a few bowed their heads slightly and remained silent.

It's weird.

Could it be that the Heavenly Demon Clan has abandoned the battle?

This is a possibility that they thought of, otherwise, how could the Heavenly Demon Clan give up such a generous reward on the combat power list?

And the Heavenly Demon Clan at this time.

In the majestic palace, a huge dragon occupies here, exuding the aura of a prosperous heavenly demon all over his body.

The light green dragon scales on it are full of luster, faintly reflecting the shadows of the other demons in the hall.

At this moment, the powerful people of the Heavenly Demon Clan, including the head of the Heavenly Demon Clan, were all here. They sat cross-legged on the ground, and their aura continued to rise, sometimes fast and sometimes slow, but they did not stop.

They are accepting Ao Qing’s gift.

This is a huge opportunity for them.
